title: Movement is not the same as settlement.
summary: It is possible to keep searching sincerely and still avoid the stillness where truth would actually meet you.
lifeApplication: Pause one extra search today and stay long enough with what you already know.

source.shortMeaning: Searching and ritual are not identical with peace.
source.lifeApplication: Do not confuse spiritual activity with inward arrival.

evidence.coreClaim: Searching and ritual are not identical with peace.
evidence.turn: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company.
evidence.practicalImplication: Pause one extra search today and stay long enough with what you already know.
